question: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) announced the highest increase in (MSP) for _____ for the Rabi Marketing Season 2020-21.
solution:
The correct answer is__** lentil.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The MSP for lentils in** 2019-20 is Rs. 4800 and in 2020-21 is Rs. 5100. The difference of Rs. 300.**
 
• So, it is the highest increase in MSP for Rabi Marketing Season 2020-21.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Minimum Support Price:**

 
 
• It is the rate at which the government purchases crops from farmers, and is based on a calculation of at least one-and-a-half times the cost of production incurred by the farmers.
 
• MSP is a "minimum price" for any crop that the government considers as remunerative for farmers and hence deserving of "support".
 
 
 
• **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs:**
 
 
• It is chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who has given its approval for the hike in the MSPs for all Kharif crops for the 2016-17 season.
 
• It keep a check on prices of agricultural products.
